headline: Last session: Indian benchmark indices snapped winning streak to record weekly losses as crude oil prices surged

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 27 October.

why: Surging crude oil prices dragging Indian equity shares down.
Sensex and Nifty 50 snapping their winning streak with a 2% weekly drop.
Crude oil prices escalating to $117/bbl impacting market sentiment.
Widespread selling pressure causing benchmark indices to drop sharply across recent trading sessions.
whatHappening: Indian stock markets are closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Tuesday, 27 October.
IDFC First Bank posted a 197% jump in Q2 PAT to ₹1,045 crore on reduced provisions.
Adani Enterprises featured as the top loser as benchmark indices dropped 2% over the week.
IT stock buying provided brief rebounds amidst overall market declines.
summary: Indian markets are closed today for the weekend. During the last trading sessions, Sensex and Nifty logged weekly losses of 2% due to rising crude oil prices reaching $117/bbl. IDFC First Bank reported strong Q2 earnings, while Adani Enterprises led weekly losses among Nifty components.
